message: Model source registry: clients can register bring-your-own-key model sources with the host through `RootState.modelSources` and the client-dispatchable `root/modelSourceSet` and `root/modelSourceRemoved` actions. Each `ModelSource` carries its `definition` and a `nonce` for it: re-registering the same `provider`, `format`, and `nonce` keeps the source's status and credential. `ModelSource.format` documents recognized values (`openaiCompatible`, `anthropic`, `azureOpenai`, `gemini`), and `definition` documents a suggested shape for each. Clients deliver each source's credential with a `modelSource` `authenticate` target, naming the key with `authenticate`'s `accountId`. The host reports status, `credentialResource`, and `accountId` with the host-only `root/modelSourceStateChanged` action, using model-source-specific auth reasons (`required`, `expired`, `rejected`, `revoked`), and ends turns on an unavailable source with the resumable `modelSourceUnavailable` error. Agents advertise the definition formats they read as `ModelSourceFormatInfo` entries in `AgentCapabilities.modelSourceRegistration`.
